031/**
032 * Orchestrates SEP-2352 registration-mechanism selection, issuer-keying, and re-registration on authorization-server
033 * migration, returning a usable {@link McpClientRegistration} for a discovered AS.
034 *
035 * <p>
036 * Given a discovered {@link OidcMetadata} (whose {@code issuer} identifies the AS and whose {@code extras} carry the
037 * RFC 7591 {@code registration_endpoint}), {@link #resolve(OidcMetadata)} selects credentials per the SEP-2352 rules:
038 * <ul>
039 *    <li><b>Pre-registered credentials</b> ({@link Builder#preRegistered(McpClientRegistration)}) are used only when
040 *       their bound {@code issuer} matches the discovered AS; a mismatch (the AS migrated) surfaces an
041 *       {@link McpAuthException} rather than silently reusing cross-AS credentials (SEP-2352 SHOULD).
042 *    <li><b>With a store</b> ({@link Builder#store(McpClientRegistrationStore)}) the issuer-keyed entry is reused without
043 *       a second DCR round-trip; on migration to a different issuer the store has no entry for the new AS, so the manager
044 *       re-registers via DCR and stores under the new issuer &mdash; the old AS's entry is never reused (SEP-2352
045 *       "MUST NOT reuse client credentials from a different authorization server").
046 *    <li><b>On-demand mode</b> (no store) performs a fresh DCR on every {@link #resolve(OidcMetadata)} call &mdash; fully
047 *       compliant (READY-312f Q8).
048 *    <li>If the AS advertises no {@code registration_endpoint} and no matching pre-registered credentials exist, an
049 *       {@link McpAuthException} is thrown (no way to obtain a {@code client_id}; CIMD is a tracked fast-follow).
050 * </ul>
051 *
052 * @since 10.0.0
053 */
054@SuppressWarnings({
055   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., ARG_value)
056})
057public class McpClientRegistrationManager {
058
059   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
060   private static final String ARG_value = "value";
061
062   /**
063    * Static creator.
064    *
065    * @return A new builder.
066    */
067   public static Builder create() {
068      return new Builder();
069   }
070
071   /**
072    * Builder.
073    */
074   public static class Builder {
075      McpClientRegistrationStore store;
076      McpClientRegistration preRegistered;
077      McpApplicationType applicationType = McpApplicationType.NATIVE;
078      Supplier<List<URI>> redirectUrisSupplier;
079      final Set<String> scopes = st();
080      boolean confidential;
081      String clientName;
082      Supplier<String> initialAccessTokenSupplier;
083      Duration httpTimeout = McpDynamicClientRegistrar.DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT;
084      Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
085      Function<OidcMetadata,McpClientRegistration> dcrOverride;
086
087      /** Constructor. */
088      protected Builder() {}
089
090      /**
091       * Sets the optional issuer-keyed credential store.  When omitted, the manager runs in on-demand mode and
092       * performs a fresh DCR on every {@code resolve(...)} call (compliant per Q8).
093       *
094       * @param value The store.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
095       * @return This object.
096       */
097      public Builder store(McpClientRegistrationStore value) {
098         store = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
099         return this;
100      }
101
102      /**
103       * Sets pre-registered (manually provisioned) credentials bound to a specific AS {@code issuer}.
104       *
105       * @param value The pre-registered credentials.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106       * @return This object.
107       */
108      public Builder preRegistered(McpClientRegistration value) {
109         preRegistered = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
110         return this;
111      }
112
113      /**
114       * Sets the {@code application_type} declared when the manager performs DCR.  Default {@link McpApplicationType#NATIVE}.
115       *
116       * @param value The application type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
117       * @return This object.
118       */
119      public Builder applicationType(McpApplicationType value) {
120         applicationType = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
121         return this;
122      }
123
124      /**
125       * Sets the redirect URIs to register when the manager performs DCR.
126       *
127       * @param values The redirect URIs (e.g. {@link LoopbackRedirectUris#portAgnostic(String)}).  Must not be
128       *    <jk>null</jk> or empty.
129       * @return This object.
130       */
131      public Builder redirectUris(List<URI> values) {
132         assertArgNotNull("values", values);
133         assertArg(! values.isEmpty(), "redirectUris must not be empty");
134         var copy = u(cp(values));
135         redirectUrisSupplier = () -> copy;
136         return this;
137      }
138
139      /**
140       * Sets a supplier of redirect URIs to register when the manager performs DCR (for the bind-first strategy where
141       * the loopback port is learned per-connection).
142       *
143       * @param value The supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
144       * @return This object.
145       */
146      public Builder redirectUrisSupplier(Supplier<List<URI>> value) {
147         redirectUrisSupplier = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
148         return this;
149      }
150
151      /**
152       * Adds scopes requested during DCR.
153       *
154       * @param values The scopes.
155       * @return This object.
156       */
157      public Builder scope(String... values) {
158         assertArgNotNull("values", values);
159         for (var v : values) {
160            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("scope", v);
161            scopes.add(v);
162         }
163         return this;
164      }
165
166      /**
167       * Registers a confidential client during DCR (default public/native).
168       *
169       * @param value <jk>true</jk> to register a confidential client.
170       * @return This object.
171       */
172      public Builder confidential(boolean value) {
173         confidential = value;
174         return this;
175      }
176
177      /**
178       * Sets the human-readable client name declared during DCR.
179       *
180       * @param value The client name.
181       * @return This object.
182       */
183      public Builder clientName(String value) {
184         clientName = assertArgNotNullOrBlank(ARG_value, value);
185         return this;
186      }
187
188      /**
189       * Sets the RFC 7591 &sect;3 initial access token for a protected registration endpoint.
190       *
191       * @param value The initial access token.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
192       * @return This object.
193       */
194      public Builder initialAccessToken(String value) {

196         initialAccessTokenSupplier = () -> value;
197         return this;
198      }
199
200      /**
201       * Sets the connect/read timeout applied to DCR requests.  Default 10 seconds.

203       * @param value The timeout.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be positive.
204       * @return This object.
205       */
206      public Builder httpTimeout(Duration value) {
207         assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
208         assertArg(!value.isZero() && !value.isNegative(), "httpTimeout must be positive (was %s)", value);
209         httpTimeout = value;

212
213      /**
214       * Sets a callback that customizes the Nimbus {@link HTTPRequest} for each DCR request.

216       * @param value The callback.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
217       * @return This object.
218       */
219      public Builder httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer<HTTPRequest> value) {
220         httpRequestConfigurator = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
221         return this;
222      }
223
224      /**
225       * Overrides the registration function the manager invokes to perform DCR (advanced / test seam).
226       *
227       * <p>
228       * The default builds an {@link McpDynamicClientRegistrar} from the discovered {@link OidcMetadata} and performs
229       * a live RFC 7591 round-trip; supply this to inject an alternate registration strategy or a stub.
230       *
231       * @param value The registration function mapping a discovered AS to an issued {@link McpClientRegistration}.
232       *    Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
233       * @return This object.
234       */
235      public Builder registrarFunction(Function<OidcMetadata,McpClientRegistration> value) {

237         return this;
238      }
239
240      /**
241       * Builds the manager.
242       *
243       * @return A new {@link McpClientRegistrationManager}.
244       */
245      public McpClientRegistrationManager build() {
246         return new McpClientRegistrationManager(this);
247      }
248   }

250   private final McpClientRegistrationStore store;
251   private final McpClientRegistration preRegistered;
252   private final McpApplicationType applicationType;
253   private final Supplier<List<URI>> redirectUrisSupplier;
254   private final Set<String> scopes;
255   private final boolean confidential;
256   private final String clientName;
257   private final Supplier<String> initialAccessTokenSupplier;
258   private final Duration httpTimeout;
259   private final Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
260   private final Function<OidcMetadata,McpClientRegistration> dcrOverride;
261
262   /**
263    * Constructor.
264    *
265    * @param b The builder.
266    */
267   protected McpClientRegistrationManager(Builder b) {
268      this.store = b.store;
269      this.preRegistered = b.preRegistered;
270      this.applicationType = b.applicationType;
271      this.redirectUrisSupplier = b.redirectUrisSupplier;
272      this.scopes = u(new LinkedHashSet<>(b.scopes));
273      this.confidential = b.confidential;
274      this.clientName = b.clientName;
275      this.initialAccessTokenSupplier = b.initialAccessTokenSupplier;
276      this.httpTimeout = b.httpTimeout;
277      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
278      this.dcrOverride = b.dcrOverride;
279   }
280
281   /**
282    * Resolves a usable client registration for the discovered authorization server, applying the SEP-2352 selection,
283    * issuer-keying, and migration rules (see the class javadoc).
284    *
285    * @param as The discovered authorization-server metadata.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
286    * @return A usable registration bound to {@code as.issuer()}.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
287    * @throws McpAuthException If credentials cannot be obtained (AS migrated away from pre-registered creds, or the AS
288    *    advertises no {@code registration_endpoint} and no matching pre-registered creds exist).
289    */
290   public McpClientRegistration resolve(OidcMetadata as) {
291      assertArgNotNull("as", as);
292      var issuer = as.issuer();
293
294      // Pre-registered credentials: use only if bound to this exact AS; a mismatch means the AS migrated (SEP-2352
295      // MUST NOT reuse cross-AS creds — SHOULD surface an error rather than silently reuse).
296      if (preRegistered != null) {
297         if (! preRegistered.issuer().equals(issuer))
298            throw new McpAuthException("Pre-registered client credentials are bound to issuer '" + preRegistered.issuer()
299               + "' but the resource now indicates a different authorization server '" + issuer
300               + "' (SEP-2352): refusing to reuse credentials across authorization servers");
301         if (store != null)
302            store.put(issuer, preRegistered);
303         return preRegistered;
304      }
305
306      // Store-hit: reuse the issuer-keyed entry without a second DCR round-trip.  On migration to a new issuer the
307      // store has no entry for it, so we fall through to DCR and store under the new issuer, never touching the old.
308      if (store != null) {
309         var hit = store.find(issuer);
310         if (hit.isPresent()) {
311            // Defensive: a buggy durable store that returns an entry keyed under the wrong issuer would otherwise
312            // cause exactly the cross-AS credential reuse SEP-2352 forbids.  Never trust the returned entry's key.
313            if (! hit.get().issuer().equals(issuer))
314               throw new McpAuthException("Client-registration store returned an entry bound to issuer '" + hit.get().issuer()
315                  + "' for a lookup of issuer '" + issuer + "' (SEP-2352): refusing to reuse credentials across authorization servers");
316            return hit.get();
317         }
318      }
319
320      var reg = register(as);
321      if (store != null)
322         store.put(issuer, reg);
323      return reg;
324   }
325
326   private McpClientRegistration register(OidcMetadata as) {
327      if (dcrOverride != null)
328         return dcrOverride.apply(as);
329      var regEndpoint = registrationEndpoint(as)
330         .orElseThrow(() -> new McpAuthException("Authorization server '" + as.issuer()
331            + "' advertises no registration_endpoint and no matching pre-registered credentials are configured"
332            + " (Dynamic Client Registration not possible; CIMD is out of scope)"));
333      if (redirectUrisSupplier == null)
334         throw new McpAuthException("McpClientRegistrationManager requires redirectUris(...) to perform Dynamic Client Registration");
335      var b = McpDynamicClientRegistrar.create()
336         .registrationEndpoint(regEndpoint)
337         .issuer(as.issuer())
338         .applicationType(applicationType)
339         .addRedirectUris(redirectUrisSupplier.get())
340         .confidential(confidential)
341         .httpTimeout(httpTimeout);
342      scopes.forEach(b::scope);
343      if (clientName != null)
344         b.clientName(clientName);
345      if (initialAccessTokenSupplier != null)
346         b.initialAccessToken(initialAccessTokenSupplier.get());
347      if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
348         b.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
349      return b.build().register();
350   }
351
352   /**
353    * Extracts the RFC 7591 {@code registration_endpoint} from the discovered AS metadata's extras, if present.
354    *
355    * <p>
356    * The value is AS-supplied, so a hostile/misconfigured AS document is defended against here: a malformed URI or a
357    * plaintext {@code http://} (non-loopback) endpoint yields the documented {@link McpAuthException} rather than a raw
358    * {@link IllegalArgumentException} (from {@code URI.create}) or a downstream {@link IllegalStateException} (from the
359    * registrar's https gate).
360    */
361   static Optional<URI> registrationEndpoint(OidcMetadata as) {
362      var v = as.extras().get("registration_endpoint");
363      if (v == null)
364         return oe();
365      URI uri;
366      try {
367         uri = URI.create(v.toString());
368      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
369         throw new McpAuthException("Authorization server advertised a malformed registration_endpoint: '" + v + "'", e);
370      }
371      if (! McpDynamicClientRegistrar.isSecureOrLoopback(uri))
372         throw new McpAuthException("Authorization server advertised a non-https registration_endpoint (loopback exempt): '" + uri + "'");
373      return o(uri);
374   }
375}
